scope: Separate same-team CPU calculation on original A800 evidence; not independent GPU replication; full local raw-copy completion not required for this audit.

fallacies.assessment: No direction reversal across repeats: calls are repeat-stable and complete-time reductions are positive in all three. Fixed blocks show mixed effects, retained in full; no subgroup-based superiority claim.
Controlled by reporting 437 wins, 360 regressions and 227 ties plus gross gains/harms. The pooled benefit is not attributed to every request.
Selection caution remains: this is the original eligible, train-disjoint but previously used GSM8K panel, not a representative fresh sample of production traffic. No inference outside that scope.
No endpoint conditioning on treatment activity, favorable calls, latency or successful-only records. All sealed requests and repeats enter; incomplete/invalid evidence would block the endpoint.
Absolute totals, the 1,024-request denominator, 120 net/792 gross saved/672 added calls and nested adaptation costs accompany percentages. The small magnitude is explicit.
Both final checkpoints were measured fresh with balanced 24/24 precedence. Historical counts authenticate K58; old timings are not used. No selection of prior extreme requests.

Full work and 6,144 executions reconcile, with zero invalid/unknown/unattempted execution exclusions. The operational failure is preserved and repaired only through complete saved-evidence validation.

Primary calls and conditional secondary complete time were fixed in advance; all repeats and blocks are reported. Diagnostic slices are not confirmatory tests. Intervals do not adjust for the wider history of experiments on this reused benchmark.

Seed, horizon, panel, count-once/mean-three rule and bootstrap were fixed before outcomes. CPU path/schema repairs and their prior bytes/failures are retained; no scientific retry, tuning, outlier removal or best-repeat choice.

A complete own-feedback recipe comparison supports this measured endpoint contrast, not isolated weight-mechanism causality. Request resampling omits fitted-seed uncertainty; diagnostic activity cannot prove why the gain arose.

Training precedes final evaluation. Priority/mixed-response activity also reflects model correctness and feedback; its association with endpoint performance is not used as directional causal evidence.

interpretation: Both prespecified gates pass for a small benefit here; primary lower interval bound is very near zero. One fitted seed and reused panel do not establish seed robustness, broad superiority, isolated mechanism causality or training-inclusive deployment speedup.
